{{Quote|Acolyte, I come with a message.|Loun greets the acolyte|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Loun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who held the title of [[Overseer (Sith)|Assistant Overseer]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While at the academy she wore [[Color/Legends|red]] and black [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Her skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were both red, while her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was black.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> she carried a message from [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Tremel]] to his new [[Empire's Wrath|acolyte]], informing the warrior that a visit to Overseer [[Rance (Sith Overseer)|Rance]] for additional training would be a good idea, as Tremel alone could not teach the acolyte all the skills necessary to succeed as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The acolyte did as asked, and visited Rance to learn new abilities.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Loun first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she is a part of the optional quest "Learning from the Best" for the [[Sith Warrior]] class, which this article assumes players completed as a part of one hundred percent game completion. If the player is a Pureblood Sith male, they can flirt with her and she will agree they are a suitable partner. If a Human male character tries to flirt with her, she says they have a chance with her, but only once they have completed their training.

A non-player character with Loun's character model makes a brief cameo in the final cutscene of ''Legacy Reborn'', the finale of the expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', but it is unknown whether this character was intended to be Loun herself or a different character entirely.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
